id: 31_Importance of Chemical Safety in Microbiology Labs laboratory biosafety microbio
title: 微生物实验室的化学品安全（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/31_Importance of Chemical Safety in Microbiology Labs laboratory biosafety microbio.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/31_Importance of Chemical Safety in Microbiology Labs laboratory biosafety microbio（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 微生物实验室也用化学品
points.S2: 搬运试剂瓶：用提篮，托瓶底
points.S3: 过期变质试剂：及时清理
points.S4: 易燃试剂，不进普通冰箱

shots.scene: 欣欣站在微生物实验室的试剂柜前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a reagent cabinet in a microbiology lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到实验室安全课。
overlay: 微生物实验室的化学品安全

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现三色圆环：烧瓶、细菌、闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Beside the panda mascot floats a three-colored ring with a flask icon, a microbe icon and a lightning bolt icon.
shots.narration: 化学、生物、物理，今天说化学。

shots.scene: 阿杰在培养基配制台前，身旁一排试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a media preparation bench next to a row of reagent bottles with pictogram labels.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：我们是做细菌的，

shots.scene: 阿杰摆手，头顶出现一个打问号的烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student waves his hand dismissively; a flask icon with a question mark appears above him.
shots.narration: 化学品安全跟我们关系不大吧？

shots.scene: 小研举起消毒剂、染色液、乙醇三个瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up three bottles: a disinfectant, a staining solution, and an ethanol bottle, each with a pictogram label.
shots.narration: 小研说：你每天都在用化学品。

shots.scene: 三个图标：手拿瓶子、储存柜、废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a gloved hand holding a bottle, a storage cabinet, and a closed waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品安全管三件事：

shots.scene: 三个图标后面出现一个大盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A large shield appears behind the three icons. No people.
shots.narration: 安全地用、安全地存、安全地处置。

shots.scene: 盾牌挡住火焰、受伤的手和枯树三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The shield blocks three icons: a flame, an injured hand, and a withered tree. No people.
shots.narration: 防止事故、伤害和环境破坏。

shots.section_title: 微生物实验室也用化学品
shots.scene: 消毒剂、染色液、乙醇、固定液瓶子排成一排
shots.prompt_en: A row of bottles with blank labels and hazard pictograms: a disinfectant, a stain, ethanol, and a fixative. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒、染色、固定、配试剂，
overlay: 微生物实验室也用化学品

shots.section_title: 微生物实验室也用化学品
shots.scene: 瓶子旁亮起火焰、腐蚀、健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: Flame, corrosion and health hazard pictograms light up next to the bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 很多都易燃、有腐蚀性或有毒，

shots.section_title: 微生物实验室也用化学品
shots.scene: 人形图标和河流图标同时出现感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A person outline and a river icon both show red exclamation marks. No people.
shots.narration: 处理不当，伤人也伤环境。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜、手套，穿实验服取试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles, gloves and a lab coat, takes a reagent bottle from the shelf.
shots.narration: 第一，保护人员。

shots.scene: 化学品蒸气飘向人形图标，被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: Chemical vapor drifts toward a person outline and is blocked by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 少接触有害化学品，

shots.scene: 三个图标：创伤、生病、日历上的远期影响
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a bandaged hand, a sick face with a thermometer, and a calendar with a slowly rising curve. No people.
shots.narration: 就少受伤、少生病、少留后患。

shots.scene: 空白操作规程卡挂在试剂台旁
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure card hangs next to a reagent bench. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，预防事故。

shots.scene: 溢洒、起火、爆炸三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a spilled bottle, a flame and an explosion burst, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 照规程做，能防溢洒、火灾、爆炸。

shots.scene: 阿杰按空白规程卡一步步操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows a blank procedure card step by step at the bench, wearing goggles.
shots.narration: 规程是用事故换来的，别跳步。

shots.scene: 废液倒向水池的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bottle pouring waste liquid into a sink, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，保护环境。

shots.scene: 土壤、河流、天空三个图标变灰
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, soil, a river and the sky, turn grey with pollution. No people.
shots.narration: 乱倒乱排，会污染土壤、水和空气。

shots.scene: 小研把废液倒进贴空白标签的收集桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours waste liquid into a closed collection container with a blank label.
shots.narration: 废液收集好，交学校统一处置。

shots.scene: 王老师举着两本空白封面的法规书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up two books with blank covers and a seal icon.
shots.narration: 第四，依法合规。

shots.scene: 空白书上浮出国徽式印章和化学品象形图
shots.prompt_en: A blank book with an official seal icon and chemical hazard pictograms floating above it. No people.
shots.narration: 国家对危险化学品有专门条例，

shots.scene: 王老师在实验室门口对照空白检查表检查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a lab against a blank checklist at the door.
shots.narration: 学校也有安全规范和检查，

shots.scene: 盾牌护住人形图标，旁边一个空白规章本
shots.prompt_en: A shield protects a person outline, next to a blank rulebook. No people.
shots.narration: 守规矩，不只为免罚，更为护人。

shots.scene: 冰箱里整齐放着贴空白标签的样品管
shots.prompt_en: A lab refrigerator with neatly arranged sample tubes with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 第五，保护样品和设备。

shots.scene: 腐蚀液滴在仪器上，仪器表面变黑
shots.prompt_en: A drop of corrosive liquid falls on an instrument, leaving a dark stain, with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品洒了漏了，会腐蚀仪器，

shots.scene: 样品管里飘进化学蒸气，样品变色
shots.prompt_en: Chemical vapor drifts into an open sample tube and the sample changes color. No people.
shots.narration: 也会污染、毁掉样品。

shots.scene: 空白数据图上的点整齐落在线上
shots.prompt_en: A blank chart with data points lined up neatly along a line. No people.
shots.narration: 第六，保证结果可靠。

shots.scene: 数据图上出现几个偏离的红点
shots.prompt_en: A few red data points jump far off the line on the chart. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂用乱了、混进去了，

shots.scene: 老周看着空白数据图摇头
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks at a blank chart with scattered points and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 结果就不准，实验白做。

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白台账本，对着试剂柜清点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student counts bottles in a reagent cabinet while ticking a blank inventory book.
shots.narration: 有多少化学品，要心里有数。

shots.scene: 入库、领用、用完三个图标连成一条线
shots.prompt_en: Three icons connected in a line: a bottle arriving, a bottle being taken out, and an empty bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 进、用、废，都记在台账上，

shots.scene: 台账本和试剂柜之间一个等号
shots.prompt_en: An equals sign between a blank inventory book and a reagent cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 定期盘点，账物相符。

shots.section_title: 搬运试剂瓶：用提篮，托瓶底
shots.scene: 单手拎着瓶颈走路的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person carrying a reagent bottle by its neck with one hand, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 搬试剂，最怕半路摔了。
overlay: 搬运试剂瓶：用提篮，托瓶底

shots.section_title: 搬运试剂瓶：用提篮，托瓶底
shots.scene: 阿杰把试剂瓶放进带隔挡的提篮里搬运
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries reagent bottles in a sturdy carrier basket with dividers.
shots.narration: 用提篮装好，一次别拿太多，

shots.section_title: 搬运试剂瓶：用提篮，托瓶底
shots.scene: 小研一手托瓶底，一手扶瓶身
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a bottle with one hand under its base and the other on its body.
shots.narration: 单瓶也要托住瓶底。

shots.section_title: 过期变质试剂：及时清理
shots.scene: 试剂柜深处一瓶标签模糊、液体变色的旧试剂
shots.prompt_en: Deep in a reagent cabinet, an old bottle with a faded label and discolored liquid, with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子深处的老试剂，也是隐患。
overlay: 过期变质试剂：及时清理

shots.section_title: 过期变质试剂：及时清理
shots.scene: 日历图标和过期标记，瓶子上打问号
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with an expired mark next to a bottle with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 过期、变质、标签不清的，

shots.section_title: 过期变质试剂：及时清理
shots.scene: 小研把旧试剂登记后放进待处置箱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student records the old bottles in a blank form and places them in a box for hazardous waste pickup.
shots.narration: 登记后交学校处置，别自己倒掉。

shots.section_title: 易燃试剂，不进普通冰箱
shots.scene: 普通冰箱里放着乙醇瓶，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary household-style refrigerator with an ethanol bottle inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃试剂要冷藏怎么办？
overlay: 易燃试剂，不进普通冰箱

shots.section_title: 易燃试剂，不进普通冰箱
shots.scene: 冰箱内灯泡和温控开关冒出火花，旁边火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside a refrigerator, the light switch and thermostat give off a small spark next to a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 普通冰箱里的电火花能点燃蒸气。

shots.section_title: 易燃试剂，不进普通冰箱
shots.scene: 王老师指着一台防爆型冰箱
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points to a dedicated explosion-proof lab refrigerator with a flammable warning sign.
shots.narration: 要用防爆或专用冰箱，按学校规定。

shots.section_title: 易燃试剂，不进普通冰箱
shots.scene: 冰箱里放食物的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of food and drinks inside a lab refrigerator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验冰箱，也绝不放食物。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在六格板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a board with six squares, each with a small icon.
shots.narration: 化学品安全，护人、防事故、护环境，

shots.scene: 六格板后三格高亮
shots.prompt_en: The last three squares of the board are highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 守法规、护样品、保结果。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴好护目镜，用提篮搬试剂，在台账上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing goggles, carries reagents in a carrier basket and signs a blank inventory book.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：原来化学品就在我手边！

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在试剂柜前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye in front of the reagent cabinet.
shots.narration: 用对、存好、处置好，下次见！
